# Rank Kiwi: Free Instagram & YouTube Outlier Analytics

> Rank Kiwi (v1.0.1) is a 100% free, lightweight, privacy-first Chrome extension for creator research, viral outlier discovery, and competitive intelligence on Instagram and YouTube. It benchmarks content against each creator's median baseline to isolate genuine breakout formats from raw subscriber inertia. Client-side execution, no login required.

## Core Capabilities & Features

- [Instagram Reels Outlier Discovery](https://rankkiwi.com/instagram-analytics/): Scans public Instagram creator profiles and the dedicated `/reels/` tab. Evaluates video Reels exclusively—filtering out static photos and carousels to preserve true video median benchmarks. Includes an in-modal 9:16 responsive HTML5 video player with seeking, duration countdown, dynamic audio soundwave visualization, and single or batch MP4 downloads (`rankkiwi_{creator}_{id}.mp4`).
- [YouTube Outlier Discovery](https://rankkiwi.com/youtube-analytics/): Analyzes channel video catalogs and YouTube Shorts with creator anti-leakage validation and live stats enrichment. Supports high-resolution thumbnail downloads (1080p `maxresdefault.jpg`) while strictly complying with YouTube policies (zero video/audio stream downloading).
- [Median Benchmark Scoring](https://rankkiwi.com/outlier-score/): Calculates non-skewed median metrics (1.0× typical, 2.0×–3.5× strong, 4.0×–10.0×+ breakout outlier) to eliminate distortion from one-off viral hits. Hidden metrics normalize to null (`—`) and sort automatically to the bottom.
- [Creator Content Research](https://rankkiwi.com/creator-content-research/): Reverse-engineers competitor content strategies, packaging patterns, and high-frequency topics directly in-browser.
- [Multi-Format Data Export](https://rankkiwi.com/docs/exports/): One-click export to native Excel spreadsheets (`.xlsx` Open Packaging Conventions workbooks created client-side via zero-dependency PKZIP Store archive), CSV, structured JSON, and rich dual-channel clipboard copy (TSV & HTML tables).
- [Client-Side Privacy Architecture](https://rankkiwi.com/privacy/): 100% in-browser processing in the Chrome sandbox with zero external database retention, zero third-party telemetry, and no account or password required.

## Research & Editorial Benchmarks

- [Rank Kiwi Research Hub](https://rankkiwi.com/research/): Original quantitative research into creator economy performance and distribution outliers.
- [Research Methodology](https://rankkiwi.com/research/methodology/): Data transparency standards, derived value rules, and editorial principles.
- [Instagram Reels vs Carousels Benchmark](https://rankkiwi.com/research/instagram-reels-vs-carousels/): Analysis of Buffer's 4M+ post study on the reach vs engagement trade-off.
- [Instagram Views by Account Size](https://rankkiwi.com/research/instagram-views-by-account-size/): Socialinsider benchmark evaluating average view scaling across 5 follower tiers.
- [One Video Doesn't Tell You How Good a Creator Is](https://rankkiwi.com/research/one-video-is-not-a-channel/): vidIQ study of 448K channels showing 10.82× spread between median first video and best of first 10.
- [448k Channel Study Dataset (CSV)](https://rankkiwi.com/research/datasets/vidiq-448k-channel-study-summary.csv): Open downloadable summary dataset covering 10 channel cohorts.
- [YouTube Upload Frequency Analysis](https://rankkiwi.com/research/youtube-upload-frequency/): vidIQ study of 10.2M channels analyzing upload cadence vs median growth rates.
- [YouTube Channel Size Rarity Census](https://rankkiwi.com/research/youtube-channel-size/): 61.2M channel census detailing milestone rarity (0.13% at 1M+ subs).
